GLS.feature.hexcrawl.title: Hexcrawl
GLS.feature.hexcrawl.hint: Turns a hex-grid Scene into an overland hexcrawl map: terrain tiles, named regions with terrain ratings, landmarks, a party token that walks hex to hex, and fog of war the GM reveals, masks or hides. System agnostic; follows the Journey to Horizon procedure without automating its rules.
GLHEX.settings.sounds.name: Hexcrawl sounds
GLHEX.settings.sounds.hint: Play a soft whoosh when hexes are revealed and a quiet step when the party token moves. Off silences them for everyone at the table.
GLHEX.settings.volume.name: Hexcrawl sound volume
GLHEX.settings.volume.hint: How loud the reveal and step sounds are on this computer.
GLHEX.settings.tooltipDelay.name: Hex tooltip delay (ms)
GLHEX.settings.tooltipDelay.hint: How long the pointer rests on a hex before its tooltip opens. Click a hex to pin its tooltip; Esc or a click elsewhere unpins it.
GLHEX.controls.scene: Hexcrawl scene: new, import, enable or disable
GLHEX.controls.undoHint: Undoes the last hex, region, terrain or scene-setting edit you made, while the hexcrawl palette is open. With the palette closed the key falls through to Foundry's own undo.
